comparison.objective: Knock a spent espresso puck from a held portafilter into a knock box, then return the portafilter.
comparison.physical_skill: Swing the held container into a bar so abrupt deceleration breaks a weak bond and ejects its contents into containment.
comparison.success_condition: Puck released into the box, portafilter returned and released; digging, dropping, or knocking outside the box invalidates.
comparison.reason: This is the closest impact neighbor, but its tested mechanism is inertial ejection by striking the container itself. The candidate instead stabilizes a separate coaxial mandrel while another hand strikes it to fracture a manufactured metal tang, protects a retained coil from lateral load, then searches for and deposits four tiny free fragments. Those are meaningfully different abilities and outcomes.
